title: Spring publishes critical advisories for Spring Security, Spring LDAP and Spring Boot
summary: Spring's advisories of 19 November rate three flaws critical. CVE-2026-59273 can allow remote code execution in Spring Security, CVE-2026-59367 is a hardcoded administrator credential on an embedded test LDAP server in Spring LDAP, and CVE-2026-59411 disables default servlet security for Actuator apps on Cloud Foundry in Spring Boot. heise says the developers cite no ongoing attacks.
plain: Spring has published three critical security advisories for Spring Security, Spring LDAP and Spring Boot; heise says the developers report no ongoing attacks.
exec: Three critical flaws affect widely used Java framework components; Spring lists fixes and heise says no attacks are reported.
action: Spring advises upgrading: open-source fixes are Spring Security 7.1.3 or 7.0.9, Spring LDAP 4.1.3 or 4.0.7, Spring Boot 4.1.3 or 4.0.10; other lines' fixes need Enterprise Support.

validation.note: Spring's own advisory pages are primary; heise Security independently reports the same flaws.
